problems: Caption 'slid past a bush' is wrong: in storyboard frame 8, row 3 frame 1 and the 50% still, the glowing ball sits half inside the bush. It passes through the leaves, and the bush neither moves nor pushes it aside.

The water does nothing when the ball goes in. In storyboard row 3 frames 3-4 and the 75% still the ball just sinks into the sea. There is no splash, no ripple and no break in the surface, so it looks like the water isn't there.

The last 4 storyboard frames (row 4, about the last 1.2 s) are almost the same: a blurred cyan blob under dark water with the shore behind it. The film ends on a dead hold, and you can't tell whether the 'sun' is resting, sinking or gone.
The ball is a plain white sphere with no surface detail, so you can't see it spin or slide. Nothing shows whether it rolls or glides, and nothing shows what pushes it from the meadow toward the bank.

The title says 'Football', but nobody kicks or touches the ball anywhere in the film. Pinchy stands next to it in frames 4-6 and the 25% still and that is all. The title promises a game the film never shows.
The camera keeps the ball on the bottom edge. It is cut off in storyboard row 2 frame 2, row 3 frames 2-3 and the 75% still, so the main subject is often half out of the frame.
posts.critique: A small glowing sun landing on a dark meadow and lighting it from below is a lovely image at the start. But the ball goes through the bush the caption says it slid past, it sinks into a sea that doesn't react at all, and the film ends on a long, unchanging shot of a glow under the water.
